description: Statutory edges: possession in the first degree, which the recorded venue rule sends to Circuit Court rather than District Court; completion of treatment rather than probation or sentence; and the two once-only edges (prior voiding under KRS 218A.275, prior KRS 218A.14151 deferred prosecution) answered at the permitted edge. Dates are absent, not synthesized. Court identity and protected fields stay blank.

boundaryUnderTest: Venue split: the recorded venue rule sends misdemeanor possession to District Court and possession in the first degree to Circuit Court. This fixture takes the Circuit Court branch.
KRS 218A.275(8) completion branch: treatment, rather than probation or the sentence itself.
KRS 218A.275(12) once-only edge: no prior voiding under the section.
KRS 218A.275(12) absolute bar edge: no prior charge dismissed after a KRS 218A.14151 deferred prosecution. The bar itself is an unratified build blocker on this track.
Waiting period edge: the registry records no waiting period independent of completion, so no elapsed-time value is set.

attachments: Proof of completion of treatment (participant obtains; LegalEase does not inspect it; the statute does not require it to be filed)
partyDataFieldNote: partyData uses the PleadingRenderInput field names petitionerName / petitionerAddress / otherNamesUsed. The role label for this track is set by presentation.movantRole in the config (Movant on the void-and-seal tracks, Applicant on the KRS 17.142(2) application), not by the fixture key name.
